transcript: Last night, my boyfriend and I attended Bad Cinderella on Broadway. Basically, it's a riff on the Cinderella story where Cinderella is trying to navigate a kingdom that's full of really fake people, and she has to let her walls down in order to find love. It wasn't my favorite, but I have to preface my critiques by saying that I was entertained the entire time, and there were some great performances throughout the piece. Everyone on stage is doing a great job, but I have some issues with the show itself. Mainly, I felt like the comedy was trying to be campy, but the jokes weren't clever enough for that to come through and overall just wasn't as funny as I think it's supposed to be. An example of this is throughout Act one, where we're learning about how most people in the kingdom only care about superficial things like looks, money, and fame. But the. Because the lines that are meant to be making fun of this just aren't very funny. Some of the lines, like the concert remarks about wanting to be skinny and wanting to be hot or just kind of uncomfortable. Also, I think if the show wanted to be camp like the way Legally Blonde the musical feels camp, the score would need to have fewer ballads and more bops. That said, my favorite 2 songs were ballads, so what do I know? Finally, there are just some noticeable plot holes and issues with Cohesiveness in terms of storytelling. But it's still in previews. And regardless, I'm very glad that I saw it.
